summary: Extends Kerberos so a client can talk to a service without revealing its identity, or revealing only its realm, and can obtain anonymous credentials from the key distribution center. It updates RFC 4120, RFC 4121 and RFC 4556. Its status is historic and it was replaced by RFC 8062.

eli5.summary: Like buying a ticket without giving your name. This lets a person prove they may enter without saying who they are.
